mission_04: Excellent work implementing the Whisper architecture! You now understand how an encoder-decoder Transformer processes speech and generates text autoregressively. The convolutional front-end efficiently extracts acoustic features from log-mel spectrograms, reducing the sequence length while capturing local patterns. The encoder Transformer builds rich contextual representations of the entire audio input, while the decoder generates text one token at a time, using self-attention with causal masking to maintain autoregressive generation and cross-attention to condition on the encoded speech. Whisper's multitask training on hundreds of thousands of hours of diverse audio data enables remarkable zero-shot capabilities across languages and tasks. The architecture you implemented demonstrates the power of combining convolutional feature extraction with Transformer-based sequence modeling for speech recognition, a pattern that has become standard in state-of-the-art ASR systems.
